evidence: 1h: Neutral (1225 полных свечей того же источника).
4h: Bearish (266 полных свечей того же источника).
risks: Доля направленных исходов ниже порога преимущества.

point.method: Causal features; purged non-overlapping matches; horizons in available candles. UP/DOWN are observed frequencies; confidence and similarity are uncalibrated scores. Wilson bound is descriptive: market dependence and selection remain.
point.data_note: Closed bars only; archive grows on successful refreshes. Broker gaps remain gaps. Horizon counts available bars, not wall-clock minutes.

backtest.method: Fixed horizon, next-open entry, close exit; non-overlapping decisions/trades. 100% notional, no leverage. Net of configured round-trip bps; no spread/slippage model. WAIT is excluded from trade win rate. No fitting or parameter optimization.
backtest.data_note: Closed bars only; archive grows on successful refreshes. Broker gaps remain gaps. Horizon counts available bars, not wall-clock minutes.
